stage1.impression: A dark, warm room with slatted timber walls, two glowing red acrylic speakers on gravelly stone plinths, and a neon-ringed armillary globe between them. At 1:1 it reads as CG: the red cabinets glow flat and pinkish like lit signage, the horn tops carry wobbly zebra reflections, the slats are perfectly uniform, the floor is a featureless plane with a hard white disc of light, and nobody is in the room. As it stands a magazine would see a generic showroom or game interior, not a specific, well-made place.

blocking_9: The Tropos acrylic must read as thick cast material with glowing polished edges and clean reflections, not flat, emissive pink panels with red-channel clipping (front band clip_pct 7.3 %).
The horn tops must show clean, undistorted reflections; they currently show warped zebra stripes of the slats.
Mother EARF's four saturated rim colours (blue, green, pink, yellow) compete with the Ember pair, so the frame has more than one colour; her rims need to sit lower in value than the pair.
The room needs life: blurred listeners, a glass, a record out of its sleeve. Right now there are 0 figures and no props.
Materials at 1:1: per-slat tone and grain variation in the oak, end-grain floor and rug texture legible, terrazzo reading as honed terrazzo rather than rough granite aggregate.
The brightest surface in the frame must be the subject, not an unexplained hotspot on the top of the wall.
Foreground composition: the dark chair back across the lower right should not wall off the right plinth and the floor.

out_of_scope.request: Make the Tropos horns and cabinets read as thick, flush, polished-edge acrylic with clean reflections, not glossy thin plastic with warped reflections
out_of_scope.why: This is the speaker's own geometry and material, which the card fixes. Only the glass reflection setting (0.3) can be tried, and it will not fix the warped horn surface.

out_of_scope.request: Lower the saturation or value of Mother EARF's coloured rims so the Ember pair is the frame's only strong colour
out_of_scope.why: Mother EARF is fixed as a product as placed. Her rim glow is part of the product.

out_of_scope.request: Vary the slat pitch or break the oak wall's rhythm
out_of_scope.why: The oak slat walls are fixed architecture. Only the oak's tone (per-slat tone and grain variation) may change, and that is recommended for the next round.
